exposure: Etiology of intestinal failure (short bowel syndrome, neuromuscular disease, other causes)
Time period (previous 10 years vs. last 5 years)
cohort: The study included 31 children receiving home parenteral nutrition for intestinal failure.
finding: The outcomes of long-term parenteral nutrition have improved over a 15-year period, despite a demographic shift toward neuromuscular disease as a leading cause of intestinal failure, which is associated with a higher burden of care.
